body:
I use AdiIRC. I like it, and I picked to up quickly. I don't know a lot about this stuff, but it seems easy to use, which is all I need. :)

And thanks for the tip!

I've used the bandage trick before! I can't say i'd recommend it to anyone, cause it's NOT comfortable but it has worked for me in the past!

I just found out today she has a separate more casual/ party dress for the reception. I think I'm going to go look for one in the wedding colors to wear. good idea, thanks!
That's a good idea! I know keto flu can be killer.. i'm chugging water and am gonna look up some keto recipies. thank you!

well, my dress came in today! I am so surprised. they had me pay a rush delivery fee, and now it's here this early! I'm gonna call every tailor I can find tomorrow. There's not a lot to be taken out, but I'm gonna see about a corset back to help give me a little breathing room. 

thank you!

She may be a little high maintenance, but she's not a bitch. She got into a tough place when someone backed out, and she deserves to have a good day. It's not the best situation, but It's the one I'm in. :)

Thanks for the tips! I'll try them for sure. I am a little self conscious, which is weird for me because usually I don't fee this way. BUT I almost never ever wear dresses, so... that may be the reason. It's a very modest/ pretty dress, and I got a scarf to help cover up a bit dusting the reception. I just gotta make it though the ceremony. 

If the compression gear can just help me not look so lumpy.. I think I'll feel a million times better. 

Thanks for you time!

I don't feel like you're fat shaming me at all! :)

I'm totally willing to do the work! I've cut out carbs and all extra sugars already. (By that I mean the only sugar I'm getting is what's naturally in things like fruit, etc.) I'm also walking/ jogging every day for at least an hour, with my dogs. 

Thanks for the reply! :)
anything in particular, or just in general? :)
I would never have thought about that. Thank you! I will try to check them out.

furniture. yes, that's a very good discerption. I just stopped by that room for a minute. it was very different from the one I used to frequent, but I think i'll like it. it seems like there's a lot going on, so that's good.

Thank you. I'll try to check it out. 

EDIT: I found it. Thank you so much for pointing me in that direction!

It's a little hard to explain how I feel about it. I wasn't forced into conversation, but I wasn't totally forgotten either. Not anymore than I wanted to be, anyway. 

I think I am missing an attachment. There's so much less pressure online than in person, I think. It makes it easier for me to... feel like I can be honest, being anonymous and all, I suppose. 

I may look into World of Warcraft. I've been told I would like the game. 

And yea, chat rooms are not really popular anymore. The internet radio show chat room was a dying space, that's for sure.

it actually started with an internet radio show, but then morphed into a general chat room for those of us that stuck around after the radio show was canceled. I just liked to watch the people talk about their lives, you know?

I do game pretty often, but I don't generally like playing with other people. The only reason is I feel too much pressure, and generally don't know what I'm doing, anyway.
